content.raw:
Keep the reasoning. Carry it forward.

MPM is an observable substrate for long-lived AI agents. Preserve what they know, why they acted, and the evidence that changed their minds.

Try MPM locallyRead the source

Alpha software. Local persistence. Open source.

A decision, with its history intact

  1. ObservationInline styles disappear from a WordPress block.
  2. DecisionStore widget CSS in the registered configuration.
  3. EvidenceA rendered-page check confirms the styles survive.
  4. Next sessionRecover the choice and the reason behind it.

Illustrative example, not live telemetry.

Four questions. One persistent foundation.

Memory is one part of the story. MPM keeps knowledge, intent, provenance, and outcomes connected across sessions.

What does the agent know?

Memories, lessons, and references preserve observations and reusable knowledge. Theories keep unproven ideas explicit.

What is it trying to accomplish?

Work records preserve progress through an immutable event history. Completion and verification are tracked separately.

Who or what produced this?

Provenance connects artifacts to their sources and the invocations that created them.

What actually happened?

Evidence and observable operations let an agent inspect outcomes and revisit its conclusions.

Reasoning that can be revisited.

A decision retains its rationale. A theory remains testable. New evidence changes the interpretation while history stays intact.

Confidence is derived from evidence. MPM preserves intellectual progress without pretending that a stored belief is the truth.

SQLite at the core
One persistent substrate with full-text and semantic retrieval. No separate vector database required.
Three ways in
A human-facing CLI, an agent-facing JSON-RPC interface, and an MCP server share the same tool registry.
Five cooperating binaries
The CLI, MCP server, scheduler, diagnostic critic, and telemetry sidecar. Invocation economics live in a separate telemetry database.
Your existing agent
Installation guides cover Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

Start with the CLI.

Build the project and try the binary before setting up background services. The README documents build prerequisites, first commands, and the full daemon installation.

git clone https://github.com/flowbyte-com/mpm ~/projects/mpm
cd ~/projects/mpm
make build

The CLI is available at bin/mpm. Agent integrations and autonomous operation are documented separately.

Follow the quick startConnect your agent

A few useful distinctions.

Does MPM run the agent?

No. MPM provides the persistent reasoning substrate. It is not an agent runtime, orchestration framework, or workflow engine.

Does it need a hosted database?

No remote SaaS service is required. SQLite provides persistence; a locally running Ollama instance can provide embedding inference for semantic recall.

Is it ready for a stable production contract?

This is an alpha release. APIs, CLI surfaces, storage formats, and schema may change. The README recommends pinning a commit when you need a specific version.
